title: Downloading a Threat Intelligence Decoy Personality

blocks.text: You can download both default and custom Threat Intelligence (TI) decoy personalities individually as a JSON file.
To download a TI decoy personality:

blocks.item: Go to Miragemaker > Strategy Builder > Threat Intelligence Decoy.
Click the Download icon for the decoy personality that you want to download.

blocks.text: The TI decoy personality is downloaded to your system as a JSON file.
